fields.description: Issue includes editorial commentary on Coral Gables city politics and the removal of George Merrick from the city commission; coverage of local and county election aftermath and political commentary; discussion of Miami Beach civic spending for conventions (Shriners and upcoming Elks) and a letter about slot-machine enforcement; notes on prohibition-era liquor trade and prices; items on public morals and health (street prostitution) and local entertainment and civic events (Bayfront Park music, theater listings), along with assorted local columns, letters, and advertisements.
